title: Elemental, about the studio
script: We started with a camera and a question. What makes a moment worth keeping? Light that means something. A story that moves. Craft you can feel. Elemental Media. Films built from the elements.

title: Elemental, about its clients
script: A brewery with decades of craft behind every pour. An airport that's the front door to its city. A coffee shop that fits in a can. Different stories. Same job: find the true thing, and film it like it matters. Elemental Media.

title: Craft brewing spot (spec / sample, not a real client ad)
script: Somewhere in Michigan, a hop field is catching the last of the light. Come autumn, it's in your glass. Brewed slow, by people who'd rather get it right than get it fast. Here's to the long way around.

title: Hometown airport spot (spec / sample, not a real client ad)
script: Short lines. Easy parking. Friendly faces who remember yours. Your next trip starts close to home, at the airport that belongs to all of us. Fly local. Fly Kalamazoo.

title: Client testimonial (sample voice, not a real client)
script: Honestly? I thought a video would be a headache. They showed up, they listened, and two weeks later we had a film our whole team shares. People still stop me to ask who made it.
